entries.description: MANDATORY handler for incoming ACCORD protocol messages. Activate immediately, before anything else, whenever your task begins with CONVENE_REQUEST, FRAME_REQUEST, GROUND_REQUEST, CLARIFY_REQUEST, VERIFY_REQUEST, or EXECUTION_REQUEST — every time, including when the request already shows you the response format. Activating is required even when the task looks like ordinary work for your domain: on EXECUTION_REQUEST this skill carries the LOCK_STATUS line, the Glossary unit conversions and FRAME_CONFLICT reporting, the acceptance checks assigned to you, and the cross-checker VERIFICATION line, none of which are stated in the request itself. Answering a prefixed task without this skill silently skips them. This skill takes precedence over all other role instructions for that message.
